gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-display: Commanding, high-rising Wallpoet sets the tone up top. Noto Sans Display, a friendly sans with tall middle zones in every word, keeps long paragraphs moving smoothly without any fuss.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-port-lligat-sans: Wallpoet draws smooth, unobstructed curves and high-rising lowercase, with paper showing through the line between its letters. Port Lligat Sans, a modern sans-serif, packs its characters tight as pins.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-ramabhadra: Commanding Wallpoet pushes high-rising lowercase and smooth curves, with paper showing through its lines, while Ramabhadra stays clean beneath. That prominent x-height lets the text stay modest in size.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Paper shows through the lines of Wallpoet's letters. Saira Semi Condensed, a modern sans, reads line after line with an unvarying weight, its text looking magnified without any change in size.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-smooch-sans: Smooch Sans reads tight and clean, its gaps nearly vanishing. Wallpoet's smooth, high-rising curves stand far apart from that packed line, and that gap is the pair's whole appeal.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Wallpoet brings smooth, unobstructed curves and high-rising lowercase, with paper showing between its letters. Sofia Sans Condensed, an approachable sans-serif with no shading to guide the eye, keeps text flowing easily.
gen-gf-wallpoet-plus-jakarta-sans: Smooth, unobstructed bends define Wallpoet, with lowercase that rises high. Plus Jakarta Sans handles the reading, precise and monoline with curve endings kept well apart, while Wallpoet handles the shouting.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-plein: Inky, stretched, loud: Warnes lets ink strokes taper out before touching, with no contrast at all. Warnes grabs attention while Plein, the reliable sans-serif, does the quiet, steady reading.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-roundo: Roundo, a geometric sans, keeps every small counter unclogged. Warnes towers above with high lowercase and stretched tracking, while Roundo stays moderate, so body text at modest sizes should still read clearly.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-spline-sans: Wide-spaced swagger: Warnes lets ink strokes thin out before touching, and none of them vary in thickness. Spline Sans, approachable and contemporary, reads smoothly through paragraphs thanks to wide gaps.
